provider: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE)
api_version: ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 0, live schema subject to updates

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only description of one official CAL FIRE POSTFIRE layer (layer 0, service item 994d3dc4569640caadbbc3198d5a3da1). Any future metadata-only request must be limited to the fixed layer path and f=pjson; no feature /query, spatial, field, pagination, geometry, SQL, edits, arbitrary URL, headers or redirects may be supplied by users. This contract intentionally does not authorize any network probe or feature export.

response_contract.format: ArcGIS FeatureServer layer metadata only (fields, type, geometryType, objectIdField, service metadata). No features array or feature rows.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: The POSTFIRE layer declares point geometry, damage-code domains, structure type, roof/siding and other inspection attributes. These are inspection observations from a selected damaged-area frame, not independently sampled insured losses or a full census of structures. Provider descriptions say digital damaged-structure records start in 2013 and no-damage structures were collected from 2018; earlier damage state denominators cannot be reconstructed naively. Field names for addresses, parcel APN and coordinates are sensitive enrichment context and remain outside any public import.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: This documented_only contract prohibits automated provider requests until exact ArcGIS service/API terms and privacy-safe extraction policy are separately approved. Never paginate or bulk download under this record.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: CAL FIRE portal lists an irregular update schedule and the upstream ArcGIS layer is mutable. Future permissible metadata receipts must freeze request identity, UTC, response byte count and SHA-256; later data receipts must freeze event/inspection time and source version.

rights_and_policy.notes: Official California portal labels this dataset Creative Commons Attribution and public access with no general public-use restrictions; exact layer/service terms, attribution, commercial automated retrieval and privacy-safe redistribution have NOT received a source-specific acceptance review. Do not infer that the CC license authorizes unrestricted API activity, public export of address/APN fields or model-input admission.
